In fact, my ideas are hardly welcome in society as a whole now, and it's extremely unnerving.

So, then I found this place, I've lurked here for a few weeks, trying to figure it all out and without a doubt can say this is the most idealistic social media platform I have found. Not because everyone agrees with me, but because a lot of you don't, and yet I am still welcome here to share ideas and thoughts without being shunned or banned. This is a place of true free speech, in a world that is slowly running out of it. I don't mean to sound all preachy, but I'd just like you all to know that what is going on here means a whole lot to people like me who no longer have a voice elsewhere.

I'm looking forward to talking and getting to know you guys.

Fifty-two blood banks in Gujarat have been extracting plasma from the blood collected through donation and have earned Rs 11.35 crore by selling the same to private pharmaceutical companies in the last three years, according to a state government affidavit filed in the High Court Monday.
